speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your history. To understand the progression of your gait and limb ataxia, have you noticed any associated symptoms like double vision, slurred speech, or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds concerning; have you experienced any sudden onset of these symptoms, or did they develop gradually over time? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision, or difficulty with swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) due to natalizumab therapy. Given your history of Crohn's disease treated with natalizumab, and the presentation of progressive gait and limb ataxia, this is highly suggestive of JC virus reactivation. I am requesting brain MRI images to confirm the diagnosis.
